Gideon Sato, here's a draft for Mateo's procurement team, built from #inc-vtg-hartford:

Hartford gate kiosk incident, Aug 3, 2026 (ticket INC-4821)
- First report: 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan, and the guard fell back to writing trailer numbers on paper.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. The guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM). The incident stays open for one more arrival cycle.
Scope: gate check-in only. Scheduling from the dispatch office kept working throughout.
Open item: Mateo's login is denied on the status page (his admin account can open Pemberline Dock). Still being chased under INC-4821.

The channel doesn't give a timezone, so the times are as posted. I haven't sent this to anyone. Mateo's team is outside pemberline.com, so emailing it would need Ruth Calloway's approval.
